_about: Settings for server.py. Copy to server.local.json (Git ignores it; on the cluster keep it in your home folder, outside the shared workspace). Paths are relative to this file unless absolute; ~ and $VARS are expanded.

_notes.bind: 127.0.0.1 on a laptop; 0.0.0.0 in a cluster job, so the tunnel through the head node can reach it.
_notes.scan_mounts: URL prefix -> folder. The prefix is where the scan paths in the data file land when the browser resolves them against /deed_reader.html (leading ../ steps stop at the root).
_notes.tokens_file: Made by make_tokens.py. Keep it in your home folder, readable by you only, never in the shared workspace or the repository.
_notes.asking the cluster's models: On only when the job's environment holds DHINFRA_API_KEY (typed at the prompt when the job is started; never put it in this file). Optional settings, with their defaults: ask_max_tokens 32768, ask_timeout 600 (seconds), ask_log (beside access_log, ask.log), ask_answers_dir (beside store_dir, answers), ask_base_url (the DHinfra API), ask_models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, the same with its thinking switched off, and GLM 5.3 Flash; a name ending :no-thinking asks without thinking).
